profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Hi, I am a Software Engineer with experience building .NET/C# desktop apps, Angular/React web apps, and ASP.NET C# APIs. I work on tools involving data visualization, data organization, and real-time info. Happy to connect!

Programming Languages: C#, Typescript, Javascript
Technologies: WPF, Angular, React, ASP.NET Core, SQL Server, PostgreSQL

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Quantitative Research Group at hedge fund manager
- Developing software tools for financial markets in C#/.NET, Blazor, WPF, and SQL Server

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Electronic Options Trading at quantitative trading firm
- Worked on the primary UI trading platform, developing .NET apps in WPF, .NET Core Web API, gRPC
positions.insights: Skills: C# · Windows Presentation Foundation (WPF) · React · TypeScript · gRPC · Microservices

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Institutional Brokerage Middle Office/Back Office at quantitative trading firm
- Improved order management desktop app built in C#/WPF, replacing legacy databases with OracleSQL
positions.insights: Skills: C# · Windows Presentation Foundation (WPF) · SQL · Oracle SQL Developer

positions.title: Software Engineer Co-op
positions.description:
- Led pair programming and developer onboarding for a team of 3 interns
- Developed core and interactive quiz user interfaces in React

positions.title: Software Engineer Co-op
positions.description:
- Developed real-time clasroom quizzes in React and React Native, bridging web and mobile users
- Launched GraphQL APIs and designed PostgreSQL databases on AWS to streamline data

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Founding software engineer of a startup developing computer vision software for self flying drones
- I was a technical lead for cross-platform web and mobile apps and helped secure $60,000 in funding

honors.title: Liberty Scholarship Program
honors.description: Drexel's Liberty Scholarship Program is a full tuition scholarship awarded to 50 Philadelphia high school graduates. The program fosters student success through a learning community where scholars can develop their professional careers and engage with Drexel's campus.

organizations.name: Collective Success Network
organizations.description: Collective Success Network (CSN) is a nonprofit that supports low-income, first-generation (LFIG) students, reach their full academic potential, and prepare them for a professional career in the workforce.
